note: YOUR AI SOUNDS LIKE AI - cream-stage, Harrison VO, 32.3s, business-casual/shareable test - solo day, EVENING slot 18:00 BST
ytTitle: Your AI Writing Has a Tell (And How to Fix It)
caption:
Your AI writing has a tell, and everyone can spot it now.

"In today's fast-paced landscape." "Delve." "A rich tapestry." "A testament to." And the em-dashes — so many em-dashes. It reads like a press release wrote it, because something did.

The fix is one line at the end of your prompt: "write how I talk, not how AI talks" — then paste two things you've actually written. It copies your voice instead of the internet's average voice.

note: CLAUDE RE-READS EVERYTHING - context/clear/compact, sack gag - solo day, EVENING slot
ytTitle: Claude Re-Reads Your Whole Chat (Use /clear and /compact)
caption:
Every message you send, Claude re-reads the entire chat.

Message one is cheap. Message fifty drags all forty-nine along with it, which is why you run out at lunch instead of midnight. It isn't that you're asking too much — it's that you never put the bag down.

Two fixes. /clear starts a fresh context for a new task. /compact keeps a summary of what matters and drops the rest, so you can carry on without the weight.

Rule of thumb: new job, new chat.
